Media Kit.name: Media Kit
Media Kit.description:
📷 You carry gear for making and sharing content.

⚖️ All of it is legal to own, and filming in public is allowed.
⚠️ Crossing a police or hero cordon for a shot is obstruction, posting private faces brings complaints, and footage can be demanded as evidence.
🤝 Handing out cards makes you easy to find for fans, sponsors and anyone with a grudge.

🎒 Starts with: Camera, Tablet, Business cards
Media Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: The character owns a camera for photos and video, a tablet for editing, notes and presentations, and a box of business cards with their name and contact details or channel. All of it is legal. Filming in public is allowed, but crossing a police or hero cordon for a shot is obstruction, posting private faces brings complaints, and footage of a crime can be demanded as evidence. Handing out cards makes the character easy to find for fans, sponsors and anyone with a grudge.
